name: Binigaus Vell
description: An old 89-hectare estate turned rural hotel, between Es Migjorn Gran and the south coast. They tell it plainly themselves: where you now rest, wheat was sown, cows were milked and Mahón-Menorca cheese was made. Twenty-seven rooms across several categories, some with a private pool, and breakfasts with pastries made in the house.
